 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Oct 24, 2026, 16:03:45 IST SUMMARY India vs New Zealand Live Score: India’s batters came to the rescue in the first T20I, helping the team chase down 226 runs and take a 1-0 lead in the five-match series. However, the bowlers have plenty to work on ahead of the second match in Christchurch on Saturday. 
 New Zealand’s aggressive batting exposed India’s weaknesses with the ball. With another batting-friendly pitch expected, the visitors will need to improve their performance to stop the hosts from scoring freely. 
 India need better performance from bowling attack 
 India’s fifth and sixth bowling options remain a concern, especially with all-rounders yet to make a strong impact in the absence of Hardik Pandya. 
 In the series opener, Nitish Kumar Reddy conceded 40 runs in four overs without taking a wicket. Naman Dhir did not get an opportunity to bowl before making a match-winning contribution with the bat. 
 India’s regular bowlers also struggled. Bhuvneshwar Kumar, playing his first match for India in nearly four years, conceded 49 runs in his four overs. He also bowled two no-balls and two wides. 
 New Zealand openers Finn Allen and Tim Seifert attacked Bhuvneshwar and Arshdeep Singh during the powerplay, putting both bowlers under pressure. 
 India vs New Zealand 2nd T20I: Squads 
 India: Shreyas Iyer (c), Abhishek Sharma, Sanju Samson (wk), Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Tilak Varma (vc), Axar Patel, Shivam Dube, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Naman Dhir, Prince Yadav, Mayank Yadav, Arshdeep Singh, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Varun Chakaravarthy, Kuldeep Yadav, Kumar Kushagra (wk). 
 New Zealand: Mitchell Santner (c), Finn Allen, Michael Bracewell, Mark Chapman, Devon Conway, Jacob Duffy, Lockie Ferguson, Zak Foulkes, Matt Henry, Bevon Jacobs, Kyle Jamieson, Adam Milne, Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips, Tim Seifert, Nathan Smith.

 15:41 (IST) Oct 24 India vs New Zealand 2nd T20I Live Score: 112/6 (14.5 overs) W Overs 14.5 Score 112 - 6 Mitchell Santner to Naman Dhir, OUT! CAUGHT! The carrot was dangled, and Naman Dhir fell for the trap. This is skilful bowling by Mitchell Santner. He is not afraid to toss it up, and this is bowled at 74 kph, probably the slowest delivery of the night from the Kiwi skipper. Dhir is made to reach out for it as he hangs low and lunges across to go inside out. The ball dips on Naman, who ends up spooning it straight to extra cover, where Glenn Phillips bends and takes the catch around his right knee. Wicket number 4 for Santner as New Zealand nip the threat of Naman Dhir in the bud. 69 needed off 31 balls.

 257 More Updates Load More India vs New Zealand Live Score: The second T20I could offer fans a chance to watch 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi bat in the middle.
Ishan Kishan has been ruled out of the match due to injury, with Kumar Kushagra joining the squad as his replacement. Sooryavanshi is expected to open alongside Abhishek Sharma, while Sanju Samson could bat at number three.
Tilak Varma is likely to return to his usual number five position after moving up the order in the first match because of Kishan's injury.
India are not the only team looking for improvements. New Zealand's bowlers also struggled to contain the visitors in the opening match.
